name: Fitness Web Phase 2
objective: Extend the local-first React fitness PoC with versioned domain storage, recurring schedules, routine management, reminders, stronger PWA caching, tests, and documentation.
exit_criteria: Existing exercise and generated-routine local data survives a versioned migration into the Phase 2 storage envelope.
Multiple named routines can be saved, selected, renamed, and deleted with a safe last-routine guard.
A weekly recurring schedule supports day, time, and routine assignments and is editable from the UI.
Recurrence and schedule behavior is covered by deterministic unit tests.
Notification permission/settings expose a clear unsupported or denied fallback without breaking the app.
The service worker precaches the built shell, versions runtime caches, removes stale caches, and has a documented update path.
README and technical decision documentation describe local-only persistence, notification limits, and PWA behavior.
The web project passes its test, lint, and build validation commands.
